reasoning: Recent state-specific general-election polling in New Hampshire’s 2026 Senate race shows Democrat Chris Pappas ahead of Republican John Sununu by margins ranging from +1 to +6, with the most recent aggregate at D+5.4 and the latest live poll at D+1.0. Based on those sources, the current Senate margin is best characterized as **D+5**; I found no qualifying New Hampshire presidential general-election poll in the last 45 days, so the Senate race is the relevant current-race measure.

sources.name: NRSC / Peak Insights
sources.details: Peak Insights poll of 500 general-election voters found Chris Pappas at 43% and John Sununu at 42%, a statistically tied race with a D+1 margin.

sources.name: Saint Anselm College
